## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed or feature implemented.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and strict typing rules of this project.
- [ ] I have run tests locally (`php tests/run-tests.php`) and verified all tests pass.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed.
- [ ] Any required documentation updates have been made.
